seo_title: Find USA Scholarships for International First-Gen Students
seo_description: Scholarships for international first-generation college students in the USA. Compare deadlines, eligibility, and award details, then apply on official pages.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships that fit both international status and a first generation college background usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and category labels. This filtered slice brings those themes together so you can apply with more focus and compare options that may connect to education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and other academic paths. The rows below are not all the same: some listings may be open to high school seniors, some to current college students, and some to graduate study. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirements can range from lighter application steps to essays or added documentation, so it is worth reading each row closely before you move forward.
